name: Hotel de Russie
insider_take: Where Roman elegance meets Secret Garden charm in the heart of the Eternal City
whats_special: Hotel de Russie boasts Rome's most enchanting terraced gardens, cascading down four levels behind the hotel - a rare oasis of tranquility just steps from the Spanish Steps. The hotel occupies a former 19th-century convent and has hosted luminaries from Picasso to Cocteau, maintaining its artistic soul through contemporary Italian design by Olga Polizzi.
pro_tip: Book a garden-facing room on the upper floors for panoramic views over the terraced gardens to St. Peter's Dome, especially magical at sunset when the gardens are illuminated.
dont_miss: The legendary Stravinskij Bar's alfresco terrace in the secret gardens - it's where Roman society mingles under centuries-old trees. Also explore the nearby Ara Pacis museum (3-minute walk) and climb Pincio Hill for breathtaking city vistas, accessible directly through Villa Borghese gardens behind the hotel.
pros: Prime location between Spanish Steps and Piazza del Popolo
Award-winning secret garden terrace and spa
Luxurious rooms with Italian marble bathrooms
cons: Historic building with some smaller room sizes
